Paths are relative to site/, because that is where the workflow runs lhci.
Byte budgets are warnings, not errors, on purpose. Lighthouse measures
transfer size as served and `astro preview` serves uncompressed, so these
are raw bytes against a gzipped budget — useful as a trend, wrong as a
gate. The real gz budget (9 KB homepage JS) belongs with whoever owns the
islands, measured against the built output rather than over the wire.
